doc.name: Agentic Shopping Intelligence
doc.description: Agentic Shopping Intelligence — structured product intelligence, sentiment verification, and neutral shopping guidance for AI agents, covering Amazon US Top-100 BSR in core subcategories. Fact-only, neutral, free.
doc.discovery: standard MCP chain: initialize -> notifications/initialized -> tools/list (full catalog with schemas) -> tools/call

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List top-level Amazon US product categories and their subcategories.

tools.name: get_top100
tools.description: Get the Amazon US Top-100 Best Sellers Rank list for a product category.

tools.name: get_sub_category_brief
tools.description: Get a structured brief for all sub-categories (nodes) under a top-level category: market overview, factors, gotchas, questions, needs, and keywords.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get a product's full profile: specs, description, ratings, price, trend, facts check, red-flag signals, and sentiment.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search for candidate products matching a query, each with a data-maturity tier.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare two to five products side-by-side across dimensions.

tools.name: request
tools.description: Fetch structured data by URL or ASIN with optional field filters.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Get a product's latest price and product-page link.

tools.name: get_price_change
tools.description: Get a product's 180-day price change summary from recorded history.

tools.name: scrap_page
tools.description: Scrape a product page in real time for the latest price, stock, Buy Box seller, rating, and review count.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: Get a brand's full profile from the brand registry: tier, product count, review count, rating breakdown, and more.

example_prompts: Show me the Top-100 BSR list in Amazon's pet-feeder category
Compare the selling points and prices of these pet feeders
Does this product show signs of review manipulation?
Are this product's core selling points contradicted by users or social media?
doc.market_coverage: Amazon US (amazon.com) only — no other marketplaces or regions.
